evidence.quote: Monetary policy has not and will not be conducted for these purposes.
Deficit financing and debt servicing issues play no role in our policy decisions and never will.
Central bank independence is critical for maintaining that target and keeping inflation expectations in line with that target.
Going forward, the monetary policy choices of the FOMC will continue to be guided solely by our mandate to promote maximum employment and stable prices.

parsed.rationale: The speech is about central bank independence and rejects fiscal dominance, which carries a mild hawkish undertone through its warnings that political control leads to excessive inflation. It gives no concrete signal about the near-term policy path, inflation, or the labor market, so the net stance is roughly neutral.
